text: Alex, this is genuinely game-changing stuff from the world of concrete production. speaker: charlie
text: That's phenomenal Jamie! And speaking of cleaning up our act, scientists have created a special type of algae that works like a magnet for microplastics in drinking water. The algae produces this orange-scented oil called limonene that binds to those nasty water-repelling microplastics and forms clumps that can be easily removed.

speaker: alice
text: I love that - nature solving problems that we've created!
